## What is this feature for?

The media library provides a cross-map view of photos without opening every place record.

## Before you start

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Where can I find it?** | Media |
| **Access** | User, Viewer |

## Where can I find it?

Follow this path in the interface : **Media**.


![Use the media library — desktop screen](/docs/screenshots/media-en-light.png)

*Use the media library — desktop screen*

![Use the media library — mobile screen](/docs/screenshots/media-en-mobile.png)

*Use the media library — mobile screen*

## How do I use it?

1. Open Media.
2. Search or filter images.
3. Open an item to inspect details and navigate to its place.

### Expected result

Only media from accessible maps is shown.

## How does it work?

- Only media from accessible maps is shown.
- Optimized thumbnails load progressively.
- Deletion actions depend on edit rights.

## Good to know

:::note
- Private trip-night photos are not automatically added to this library.
:::
